reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "HelmRepository v1beta2 schema: 1 field now required: `status.artifact.digest`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: resource-rejected

consequence.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository schema, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, so the API server rejects objects or status writes that set status.artifact without a digest.
consequence.remediation: Make sure every client or controller that writes HelmRepository v1beta2 status fills in status.artifact.digest.

proposed.statement: The source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository CRD schema now requires status.artifact.digest, so objects that leave it out are rejected.
